matches.rationale: No finding addresses the inconsistency between the tabulated sample efficiency metrics in Figure 6(b) and the learning curves in Figure 6(a).

The findings mention a sign error (pred_id 1) or a cross-section inconsistency (pred_id 2), but the ground truth describes an ambiguous mention of 'negative advantage estimates' that conflicts with the positively signed formula; neither finding captures this exact ambiguity.
No finding mentions the selective reporting of the hyperparameter p or the lack of disclosure regarding environment-specific values in the main results.

Finding 4 identifies that the abstract claims IIF completely eliminates sample inefficiency and solves training instability, while experiments show only partial improvements, which directly matches the ground truth's overstatement and supporting evidence.
The finding about a missing 'Kumar et al. (2024)' citation (pred_id 3) does not match the ground truth concerning suspicious or fabricated 'Deng et al., 2025' and 'Cheng et al., 2025' citations.
No finding discusses the omission of ethical considerations, safety risks, or societal impact discussion in the RLHF toxicity mitigation experiments.
Finding 4 addresses exaggerated claims in the abstract, but the ground truth specifies marketing-style language and rhetorical exaggeration in the Introduction, which is not detected separately.

Finding 5 uncovers contradictory statements about the reference policy (fixed vs. dynamic) within Section 3.1, capturing the same underlying inconsistency as the ground truth's cross-section misalignment between Section 3.1 and Appendix A.2.
No finding identifies the manipulated y-axis ranges in Figure 6(a) that visually exaggerate performance differences.
No finding mentions the asymmetric hyperparameter tuning between IIF and the PPO baseline or the resulting unfair experimental comparison.
No finding addresses the overclaim of consistent improvement in Section 5.2 in light of wide confidence intervals and performance degradation shown in appendices.
No finding discusses the missing learning rate η in the influence score formula or the inconsistent usage of θ_j^{(k)} in Section 3.1.
No finding mentions selective environment reporting or missing negative results.
No finding points out the misattribution of the f^{return} formulation to standard REINFORCE with a baseline.
No finding identifies the contradiction between the main text's claim of 'negligible overhead' and the detailed timing breakdown in Appendix B.9/Table 6.
